messages:
Sam: Quick RN drop for model-server v2.4.0. Need pin and a short stage-gate at 10:30 PT. Can someone own pin + deploybot?
Ivy: Happy to. Request pin label `v2.4.0-rn-2024-06b`.
Ravi: Recommend rollout: dry-run -> canary 4% 7m -> 25% 8m -> 100%. Rollback: revert to v2.3.5 and disable new-tokenizer flag.
SRE Oncall: I've reserved 10:25-11:00 window. I'll monitor p95 and 5xx; alert if 5xx > 0.9% for 3m.
deploy-bot: queued deploy 87200 | env=prod | image=model-server:v2.4.0 | strategy=canary(4%,7m)->25%(8m)->100% | requested_by=Ivy | pin_label=v2.4.0-rn-2024-06b
Ivy: running dry-run at 10:20. If green, announce at 10:28 and start at 10:30.
Sam: RN blurb: "Improves multi-chunk throughput and reduces p95 for long contexts. Note: minor token boundary behavior change; see rollback instructions."
deploy-bot: job 87200 dry-run passed at 10:22. Ready for scheduled rollout.
Ivy: Posting internal announce: "Deploying model-server v2.4.0 (pin v2.4.0-rn-2024-06b) at 10:30 PT. Canary rollout. Standby: @SRE Oncall @Ivy @Ravi."
deploy-bot: job 87200 status: canary(4%) started at 10:30.
SRE Oncall: initial canary metrics look stable. Proceeding to next step at 10:38 if green.
deploy-bot: job 87200 status: canary(25%) started at 10:39.
Ravi: observing warmup; KV cache warmed. No errors.
deploy-bot: job 87200 status: 100% started at 10:48. job 87200 status: success at 10:52.
Sam: RN finalized and pinned. I'll update CHANGELOG with the pin label and close thread.
Ivy: Thanks team. Closing.
